Hi Sofia,

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing & required template fields

Hi Elena —

Welcome — excited to get Scalada set up. Short answers up front, followed by recommended steps: 

1) Portal vs email: We prefer the vendor portal for recurring suppliers. Portal uploads get auto-validated (PO matching, required fields) and hit AP queues faster. Email invoices are accepted as a fallback but usually add 1-2 business days for manual routing.

2) PO requirement: Product/hardware purchases require a PO number to match receipts. For contracted services, include the contract reference and SOW number; PO is preferred but not strictly required for services if you reference the contract and include a vendor onboarding ID (we'll issue one at activation).

3) Required invoice fields (see attached template):
   - Redwood PO Number (or Contract Ref) — IMPORTANT
   - Invoice date and unique invoice number
   - Line descriptions and quantities (or service period)
   - Line-level unit price and line total
   - Tax ID / VAT number
   - Remit-to address and bank details or ACH instructions
   - Payment terms (our standard is Net 45 unless otherwise agreed)

4) GL codes: Not required on the first pass; include them if your system can provide them but AP will map lines where necessary.

Attached: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx — please complete the onboarding form and, if possible, submit your first invoice via the portal link below. If you must email an invoice for the first one, send to ap@redwoodinference.com and copy me.

Portal link: https://app.redwoodinference.com/vendors/upload

If you hit any validation errors after upload, send screenshots and I'll loop in Marissa (she handles exceptions).

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Programs Manager

- Our billing system outputs a consolidated invoice format; is the Redwood template mandatory or can we provide a PDF consolidated invoice plus a CSV of line details?

Hi Elena —

Quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Subcontractor/pass-through invoices: We do not require a separate PO per subcontractor. For pass-throughs, include the prime contract reference and attach the subcontractor invoice as backup. AP will accept the consolidated invoice if the supporting subcontractor docs are available. We may request additional detail during the first two invoices for mapping.

- Expedited reviews: Yes — please put "EXPEDITE: AP REVIEW REQUEST" in the subject and copy ap@redwoodinference.com and myself. We can triage within 48 hours for genuine emergencies, but payment terms don't change unless we approve a remedy.

- Consolidated PDF + CSV: That is acceptable. The invoice template is preferred because it auto-validates, but if you provide the consolidated PDF and a CSV with the required fields (PO/Contract Ref, invoice line description, qty, unit price, tax, line total), AP will ingest it. Please make sure the CSV uses UTF-8 and comma separators.

Next steps: 
- Sofia will run activation once you submit the onboarding form.
- After activation, submit your first invoice via the portal and mark it as "First invoice - activation pending" in the notes so AP routes properly.

Looping back to Sofia for activation timeline.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
